title: Talking About Skills and Motivation
summary: Explaining why you want a role and what skills you bring.
whyItMatters: Interview and application answers must connect motivation, evidence, and the employer's needs rather than simply list positive adjectives.

mentalModel.title: Motivation links you to the role
mentalModel.content: Explain what attracts you, why it matters, and how it fits your direction.

mentalModel.title: Skill answers need proof
mentalModel.content: Name the skill, give a concise example, and state the useful result.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect motivation to concrete work
ruleBlocks.content: Name tasks, values, or development opportunities rather than prestige alone.

ruleBlocks.title: Use a situation-action-result example
ruleBlocks.content: Show where the skill appeared and what changed because of your action.

ruleBlocks.title: Return the answer to the role
ruleBlocks.content: Close by explaining how the example will help in the advertised position.

ruleBlocks.title: Discuss development honestly
ruleBlocks.content: Name a real area, the action you are taking, and visible progress.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: An dieser Stelle interessiert mich besonders, dass ...
Das habe ich zum Beispiel gezeigt, als ...
Diese Erfahrung kann ich in Ihrem Team gut einsetzen.

tables.title: A Strong Skills Answer
rows: Ich kann komplexe Aufgaben gut organisieren.
Im Praktikum musste ich drei Termine gleichzeitig koordinieren.
Ich habe Prioritäten gesetzt und alle Beteiligten informiert.
Dadurch fand die Veranstaltung pünktlich statt.

sentenceStructure: Answer the question directly before adding context.
Use a short narrative for evidence.

comparisons.summary: The theme lesson supplies application vocabulary and evidence categories.
Relative patterns help foreground what matters and where experience occurred.

examples.de: An der Stelle interessiert mich besonders, dass ich internationale Projekte unterstützen kann.
examples.en: What interests me especially about the position is that I can support international projects.

examples.de: Was ich mitbringe, ist Erfahrung in der Organisation von Veranstaltungen.
examples.en: What I bring is experience organizing events.

examples.de: Meine Zuverlässigkeit habe ich gezeigt, als ich kurzfristig eine Vertretung übernommen habe.
examples.en: I demonstrated my reliability when I took over cover at short notice.

examples.de: Dadurch konnte das Team die Frist trotzdem einhalten.
examples.en: As a result, the team was still able to meet the deadline.

examples.de: Ich arbeite daran, Präsentationen noch sicherer auf Deutsch zu halten.
examples.en: I am working on giving presentations in German with more confidence.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich bin motiviert, flexibel, kreativ und teamfähig.
commonMistakes.correct: Select relevant qualities and prove each with an example.
commonMistakes.reason: A list is less credible than evidence.

commonMistakes.wrong: Talk only about what the company can give you.
commonMistakes.correct: Connect your development goals to the contribution you can make.

commonMistakes.wrong: Name a serious requirement as a weakness without a plan.
commonMistakes.correct: Choose a manageable development area and describe action and progress.
commonMistakes.reason: The answer should demonstrate reflection and learning.

tips: Keep each answer under two minutes.
Use the vacancy's vocabulary naturally, not mechanically.
